matched.note: Same root cause: CheckPolicy short-circuits to nil,nil on a policyBase error whenever the passed-in (working-tree) policy.Mode is free, before basePolicy() ever substitutes the base-authoritative policy — so an attacker-edited acdsl/policy.json with mode=free plus an unresolvable base_ref (e.g. no-such-ref) defeats the gate with zero diagnostics. Golden line 199 predates a later line shift; candidate correctly pins the actual bug at CheckPolicy L329-333 in the current tree.

SP-003 isolates the same coverage gap GV3-108 bundles as one of three untested edge branches: CheckPolicy free+unresolvable-base is never exercised. Verified in internal/acdsl/policy_test.go: TestCheckPolicyUnresolvableBase only sets mode=gated with BaseRef=nosuchref; no test sets mode=free with an unresolvable base_ref, so the SP-001 bypass path is untested.
